facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

assets.label: hydrocarbon transfer pumps
assets.service: hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of P-4105

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4105 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4105 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 11 October 2012 a hazard report was recorded on P-4105 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
